steps: get_references roman gladius (straight double-edged blade, triangular point, hemispherical guard, ribbed grip, ball pommel)
make_tool with the single MeshPart as Handle
authored 3-keypose rightArm swing clip GladiusSlash (windup 0s, strike 0.28s, recover 0.65s) on workspace.AgentRig
fit Grip (offset 0,-1.1,0; rot rx-90) via grip_tool + numeric probe, restored rig state, moved Tool to StarterPack

recipe.text: Roman gladius short sword — distinct from prior falchion/scimitar/dagger/spear artifacts. Cube mesh from reference-listed features (slender straight blade, triangular tip, small guard, ball pommel) at 3.4 studs (hand-weapon scale per learned rule), persisted with save_mesh. CAVEAT: CaptureService produced no screenshots all session (headless/unfocused Studio), so visual checks were replaced by numeric verification: mesh extents 0.6x3.4x0.6, grip probed via world-space end-point math (blade axis along handle -Y, gripped 1.1 studs from pommel end, rx-90 points blade forward out of the fist). Fast swing: 3-keypose rightArm clip bound to 'use', behavior 0.12/0.15/0.33s, hitbox 20 dmg / 7 studs / 0.6s server cooldown.
